finding: A pagination receipt that records only next_url terminality does not prove traversal continuity; each page must bind its recorded next_url to the exact request_url of the following retained page.

primary_sources.title: GitHub REST API pagination documentation
primary_sources.observed: GitHub specifies that the Link header's rel=next URL is used to request the next page and pagination ends when no next link remains.

verification.environment: isolated local Node runtime before repository commit

uncertainty: No authenticated private-repository enumeration was executed in this slice.
The verifier proves retained-link continuity, not response-body authenticity, semantic completeness, provider absence, deployment identity, or device behavior.
falsification_route: Provide a retained receipt whose next_url differs from the following request_url, repeats a prior request_url, contains a sensitive query key, or leaves the final page nonterminal; the verifier must fail closed.
privacy_boundary: No credentials, private response bodies, personal identifiers, or private source material are retained.
